profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
Senior technical leader with deep experience designing and delivering large-scale real-time systems, engine infrastructure, and developer tooling.

I spent the bulk of my career at Amazon Games, working across individual contributor and engineering leadership roles on a proprietary MMO engine powering a live, cross-platform title. My work has spanned core runtime systems, world streaming, rendering, large-scale tools, and editor workflows, with a strong focus on performance, memory efficiency, stability, and developer experience.

I specialize in ambiguous, multi-year technical problems and driving them from architecture through incremental delivery, particularly in environments that demand careful technical judgement and cross-disciplinary collaboration.

While I've led teams and grown senior engineers, my primary strength is as a hands on technical lead: setting direction, unblocking execution, and building systems that teams rely on at scale.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Manager
positions.description:
Hands-on Senior Software Development Manager leading a ~20-person organization delivering core MMO engine systems and tools for an open-world game and large-scale game data. Deep ownership of engine architecture across client, server, and editor with focus on execution, stability, and long-term technical vision.

• Led development of client world streaming improvements, delivering improved streaming performance and rendering gains through instancing, mesh merging, Simplygon-driven mesh optimization, and entity/component reduction
• Led editor-side open-world streaming initiative, reducing editor memory usage by 10-20GB, improving editor performance, and delivering ~2x speed-up for world art and design development workflows
• Drove engine tools engineering strategy and execution, delivering stability improvements, performance optimization, and workflow enhancements across the toolchain for ~200 developer team
• Established tools prioritization framework by aggregating cross-functional feedback from art, design, and engineering teams, driving high-impact backlog decisions and resolving critical blocking issues
• Owned engine tools stability for ~120 daily editor users on bleeding-edge code and assets, maintaining an average of <1 crash per user-day and ~30 crashes per 1,000 editor-hours at scale
• Led hiring for directly managed team and participated in ~100 interviews across the broader game engineering organization, directly managed 6 engineers and sponsored 2 successful career promotions

Shipped Titles: New World: Rise of the Angry Earth (2023, PC), New World: Aeternum (2024, PC / PS5 / Xbox Series X|S)

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer | Core Engine, Tools, and Graphics
positions.description:
Promoted from Software Development Engineer to Senior Software Development Engineer in 2020.

Served as core engine and tools lead, owning open-world authoring tools, asset data processing and bake pipelines, entity/component tooling, and game asset workflows across runtime and editor.

• Architected a streaming terrain rendering system with multilayer material support, dynamic texture compositing, virtual texturing, and runtime texture compression.
• Owned and led development of the vegetation system runtime and tooling, supporting large-scale procedural placement (millions of instances per km²), spatial instance batching, and multi-threaded streaming.
• Led development of asset data bake pipelines, defining architecture and technical standards and guiding implementation across vegetation processing, mesh merging, imposter generation, and game metadata aggregation.
• Led a sustained engineering effort to eliminate flaky asset processing failures by resolving systemic flaws in game asset data authoring workflows; redesigned tooling to detect malformed data, enforce determinism, auto-remediate common error modes, and guide users through safe resolution paths. Driving flaky asset errors to zero established Asset CI as a reliable signal for build stability.
• Designed and delivered table-based game asset data tooling enabling fast navigation and safe mass-editing workflows. The tool became an integral part of daily workflows for designers, remaining in active use for 5+ years, saving thousands of hours in aggregate.

Shipped Titles: New World (2021, PC)

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
• Established physically based rendering content pipeline with Substance tools, integrating shaders and automating asset export workflows
• Designed and optimized rendering and GPU systems, including decals, draw-call reduction, and memory bandwidth improvements
• Built tools and systems for art memory budgeting, character data workflows, and procedural terrain effects
• Hardened multiplayer networking (P2P and client/server), resolving synchronization and threading issues
• Helped drive adoption of formal code reviews and improved branching/build practices

Shipped Title: Kill Strain (PS4)

positions.title: Graphics Programmer
positions.description:
• Delivered OpenGL ES 3.0 emulator for Qualcomm and built showcase applications using NDK/Adreno SDK
• Integrated AMD TressFX hair rendering into Tomb Raider (PC, 2013) and ported graphics systems to Xbox One
• Extended graphics middleware, transitioned post-processing systems to compute-shader implementations
• Consulted with studios on advanced rendering features including hair, skin, and screen-space reflections
• Brief sabbatical Apr-Aug 2012 to complete master's degree thesis

positions.title: Graduate Student
positions.description:
Master's Degree in Computer Science
Emphasis on Computer Graphics and Vision
Thesis: Higher Order Light Propagation Volumes

• Graded exams and programming assignments
